B4N1-AUDIT — END USER LICENSE AGREEMENT (BINARIES)
==================================================

Version: 1.0 | Effective: 2026-11-23 | Applies to: b4n1-audit 0.1.5+

This End User License Agreement ("EULA") governs your use of the B4N1
BINARY ARTIFACTS of b4n1-audit — the bundled per-platform `b4n1-audit`
executables (`b4n1-audit-linux-amd64`, `b4n1-audit-linux-arm64`,
`b4n1-audit-linux-ia32`, `b4n1-audit-macos-x64`,
`b4n1-audit-macos-arm64`, `b4n1-audit-windows-amd64.exe`
and the remaining platform builds shipped under each SDK's `bin/`
directory), the packaged per-language bindings (`*.whl`, npm tarball,
`*.jar`, `*.nupkg`, gem, composer package, Go module), and the
`b4n1-audit` standalone executable.

The SDK wrapper source files (the thin per-language bindings) are licensed
separately under the Business Source License 1.1 — see the `LICENSE` file
and each registry's license metadata.

1. DEFINITIONS
   "Binaries" means the compiled artifacts described above.
   "SDK" means the BUSL-1.1 licensed wrapper source distributed for each language.
   "Source" means the Rust implementation, scanner rule set, build scripts,
   internal tests and internal documentation of the B4N1 engine. Source is
   NOT distributed under this EULA or any other license and remains
   proprietary.

4. SUBSCRIPTION TIERS
   The Binaries operate under the applicable tier, validated offline against a
